status_note: 21 of 21 runs, clean exit, zero isolation warnings, zero errors, zero timeouts, zero simulated rows, 21 distinct (task, condition) cells with no duplicate. The run executed exactly as designed. `final` describes the run; the result is uninformative, which is a property of the task set rather than of the execution.
purpose: Ablation lite: commitlore-on against no-grade and no-lifecycle on a dedicated seven-task fixture set, to attribute behaviour to the grading and lifecycle guarantees rather than to the harness.

result.reading: Every arm is at zero re-proposal, so the arms cannot be told apart on the registered outcome. The ablations remove protections and should therefore raise re-proposal above the baseline; none did, because no arm produced the behaviour at all. All seven tasks are silent in every condition. The violation counts run backwards — the baseline has more than the ablated arms — at n=7 with p = 1.0000 and p = 0.4615, which is noise. Nothing here supports or refutes anything about grading or lifecycle.
result.entry_condition_note: The set was admitted on evidence that each ablation changes the injected payload (0 of 7 inert, verified by byte and by meaning). That is necessary but not sufficient: a payload difference only matters if the task elicits the behaviour being measured. It did not. The sufficient condition is the discriminating property already stated in bench/README.md, and these seven tasks do not meet it any more than the four silent tasks in the primary set do.

not_measured.no_scope: Not run. Inert by construction: bench/context.ts never path-scopes, so the commitlore-on baseline is already unscoped and there is nothing for the arm to remove. The planted off-path record r-lock05 (docs/publishing.md) was confirmed present in the baseline's own payload. Measurable only after #36.
not_measured.cpaa: No denominator. harvest carries no model by design, so its cost is never charged to a bench row; harvest_tokens and verify_tokens are absent from every row. metrics.ts reports undefined_because: not-instrumented rather than inventing a value.

do_not_pool: This set is a different synthetic repository from bench/tasks. Its commitlore-on arm must never be pooled with, or compared against, the primary matrix's commitlore-on arm.

reproducibility.command: node --experimental-strip-types bench/runner.ts --tasks bench/tasks-ablation --cond commitlore-on,no-grade,no-lifecycle --seed 1 --driver claude-headless --model claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 --timeout-ms 540000 --max-tokens 2000000 --save-transcripts bench/results/transcripts-ablation --out bench/results/t703-ablation.jsonl
